title: Red Hat Security Advisory: gimp security update
description: A stack buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the PSD image resource header loader of GIMP (GNU Image Manipulation Program). This issue is identified as CVE-2026-119528 and affects Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support versions. The vulnerability could potentially allow an attacker to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code via a crafted PSD image file. Red Hat has released an important security update to address this flaw in GIMP version 3.0.4-4.el9_8.16.
